DEFF 1.3 stays an assumption (unmeasurable at 4 trees; p < 0.05 holds to DEFF 5.4). P1-P4 HELD (Brier 0.2025). Licenses: the per-site certificate carries declared-category alignment beyond site size ON THESE TREES; not correctness, not FDR certification, not other corpora or embedders. plain_description.what: On four MMLU-Pro trees built without any category labels, compares splits that passed the statistical 'site certificate' with uncertified splits of similar size, on how well each matches MMLU-Pro's declared subject categories.
plain_description.why: Checks that the certificate is not just rewarding big splits, i.e. that it carries real information about meaningful structure.
plain_description.information: If certified splits align better at equal size, the certificate means more than 'large'; if not, it is mostly a size filter. Result: done; certified splits align better (+0.063 on a 0-1 agreement scale, permutation p 0.0001), holding under every size control though about 0.01-0.016 smaller, and size is not fully matched in the largest group. Valid on these trees only; it does not show splits are 'correct', nor other corpora or embedders.
